title: Last Resort Disc Golf Course

services.name: Last Resort Disc Golf
services.desc: Layouts Updated September 2025!!! New novice layout “Turkey Layout” has been added! 21 hole layout (Par 64). This is a BRAND NEW to 2025 Disc Golf course located in Conifer CO. Course is situated on the historic Resort Valley Ranch. The name comes from Last Resort Creek that flows through the property, a name that comes from the original homesteaders of this land. The course is situated in mixed forest/ open meadows and rocks. Golden Eagle layout (par 60)-A 19 basket course with many long technical shots. Some wide open, many with some fun obstacles. All shots are par 3 with the exception of #12, #14, and #15 being par four for a total par of 60 for this layout. This course is ever evolving
